notes: price_per_unit 0.0035/g confirmed by Shahab 2026-09-14 - COOKED-gram basis (rice-parity; sticker ~$1-1.30/lb raw x ~1.2-1.25 peel/boil yield factor lands here).

FRAME: FED-STATE basis per the rice 10033 precedent (boiled-drained) - the DB's starches store what recipes weigh and feed. SR 170440 'boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt' = peeled, boiled, unsalted, exactly the customer prep. First MANDATORY-COOK ingredient (distinct from the steam-lightly veg class): raw potato is unsafe for cats (glycoalkaloids + indigestible raw starch).

CUSTOMER GUIDANCE (three hard rules for the popup): never raw; never green or sprouted potatoes (glycoalkaloids concentrate under skin and in sprouts - peeling + discarding green ones removes the hazard); boil in plain water, no salt.

FOUNDATION deliberately NOT paired: FND has only RAW entries (russet/red/gold 2346401-03, 2022 study, n=8) - frame-mismatched with the fed state. They serve as retention ANCHORS instead: raw K 450 (n=8) -> SR boiled 328 is the expected ~27% boil leach - coherent, validating the cooked entry's modern relevance. SR-primary food like rice.

PURPOSE: second starch, GRAIN-FREE alternative to rice 10033 (same role, same price); bonus mild Met dilution (Met 0.027 -> 0.31/1000 kcal); K-rich (328 cooked) toward the potassium minimum in meat-heavy recipes.

PRODUCE DOCTRINE expectations: taurine 0 (plant biochemical zero, literature row), vit A -> 0 species-correct if the SR row is carotene-RAE (potato ~nil anyway), vit K = K1-only IS complete for plants (no menaquinone misfire), D/B12 zeros are true zeros.

Panel: SR 170440 has 100 nutrients incl. full 12/12 AA panel; only the standard four gaps (taurine, Cl, iodine, biotin). Iodine gets a FRAME-EXACT US TDS entry (11367 peeled boiled) - no cooking back-adjustment needed, a first.
All seven sources are BOILED-frame-matched - the richest frame-exact coverage of any add: FCDB 801, BLS K110132, MEXT 02019, CIQUAL 4003, CoFID 13-490, AFCD F007320, TDS 11367.
